notes:
Account snapshot: enterprise FS firm building client-facing chat and real-time QA for trade desk tooling. Primary concerns: guaranteed throughput per reserved GPU, hard p99 latency commitments, and predictable cost when bursting.

POC / evaluation context:
- Running evaluation against mixed workload: 60% chat (<=128 tokens), 30% reranking, 10% embeddings.
- Target SLOs: p95 < 100ms (short chats), p99 < 300ms; baseline throughput target equivalent to 1,200 chat qps during market hours.
- Initial sizing proposed: 8x H100 for reserved baseline, warm pool to support burst to 16 within 30s.

Autoscaling & capacity management notes (detailed):
- Desired scale-up policy: reactive + predictive hybrid. Reactive rule: scale-up when queue depth > 25 requests sustained for 20s OR CPU/GPU util > 78% for 30s. Predictive rule: pre-scale based on scheduled market open spikes and historical minute-level QPS.
- Scale-down policy: prefer conservative scale-down to avoid cache cold starts. Proposed: scale-down only when instance idle time > 10 minutes AND queue depth == 0, with a cooldown of 5 minutes between scale actions.
- Warm pool behavior: want warm pool of 20% of peak baseline (~3 pre-warmed nodes) with KV cache pre-populated for top-100 prompt prefixes. Warm pool must support zero cold-starts for typical reranking requests.
- Queueing behavior: soft-queue with request prioritization (interactive chat > reranking > background embeddings). Soft-queue allowed max wait 10s; if wait exceeds 10s, fallback to smaller lower-cost model or shed to best-effort queue. Hard-queue rejection only when overall cluster resources exhausted.
- Batching & latency: require per-route batching caps; short-chat route should be single-request fast-path with batching disabled at batch sizes >1 for latency-sensitive paths.
- Throughput guarantees: negotiating guaranteed vCPU/GPU slots and tokens/sec per reserved GPU; they want a contractual minimum of sustained throughput per GPU with credits if provider fails.

SLA & commercial negotiation items:
- P99 SLA window and credit calculation: customer pushes for p99 < 300ms measured at edge with 99.9% uptime; they want daily mitigations and credits for sustained breaches >5 mins.
- Throughput SLA: minimum concurrent slots per reserved GPU (e.g., 8 low-latency slots) + documented degradation policy (graceful fallback to smaller models).
- Pre-warm / warm-pool commitments: want guaranteed pre-warm capacity during market open (08:30–10:30 ET) and during earnings windows.
- Penalty cap: customer requests uncapped credits for first 6 months of production until behavior stabilizes; Redwood to push back with capped credit schedule.

POC results & engineering feedback:
- Stress test (2026-02-28): baseline 8 H100 config meets p95 targets for 95% of test windows; p99 spikes on simultaneous long context (>2k tokens) and heavy beam/rerank ops.
- SE notes: suggest mixed cluster of H100 + a few A100 burst nodes for cost efficiency; aggressive KV caching and prefix caching reduced token compute by ~18% in bench.
- Suggested configuration v2: reserve 8 H100 baseline + 4 spot/burst A100 nodes in warm pool (policy: warm to 4 nodes within 45s).

Action items + next steps (short):
- Redwood: produce SLA draft w/ p95/p99 definitions, credit schedule, and throughput spec (due 2026-03-07).
- SE (Priya): produce updated sizing workbook with warm-pool sizing and pre-warm scripts (due 2026-03-05).
- Customer: confirm exec sponsor availability for procurement review (target 2026-03-15).

Quotes / customer color:
- "We need predictable tail latency during market opens; spikes cost us in downstream pipelines." — Head of ML Ops
- "If warm pool can't be guaranteed, we will need to keep a larger reserved fleet which bumps cost significantly." — CTO

Open risks / blockers:
- Legal: final SLA language on credits and uptime definitions (IN PROGRESS).
- Networking: direct connect / peering for on-prem gateway; procurement timeline unknown.
- Budget: CFO sign-off required for reserved ARR commitment.

CRM shorthand: eval->tight on p99; prefers contract language that maps to scale actions + warm-pool guarantees. Prioritize dedicated+private combo.
